parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
$\angle APQ=\cos^{-1}(5/6)$ — *M1; may use cosine rule for $\angle APB$; an incorrect multiple of $\pi$ is M0.
$\angle APQ=0.5857$ — A1; accept 0.586 or $33.6^\circ$, or $\angle APB=1.171$ or $67.1^\circ$.
Perimeter $=4r\times\text{their }0.5857$ — DM1; must use a numerical value of their angle.
$2.34r$, or $0.745\pi r$, or $(293/125)r$ — A1.
Total: 4

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Use sector formula: sector $APB=\frac12r^2(2\times\text{their }0.5857)$, or sector $APC=\frac12r^2(\text{their }0.5857)$ — M1; appropriate numerical angle must be clear.
Use appropriate triangle formula and correctly combine with sector to find a half-segment, one segment or both; e.g. area $APB=\frac12r^2\sin(2\times\text{their }0.5857)$ — M1.
Shaded area $=2\times0.1250r^2=0.250r^2$ — A1; accept $0.0796\pi r^2$, $r^2/4$ or $0.25r^2$.
Total: 3
